title: Shared ONNX singleton with mutable streamStates used by both screens
impact: State reset mid-stream corrupts audio; resetDenoiser can release session during inference
fix: Give each consumer its own session/StreamState; guard reset with in-flight counter

title: 6 real tsc errors: 5x COLORS.textSecondary undefined + 1x ATTEN_PRESET_DB indexing
impact: Undefined text color in shipped UI; strict typecheck fails; latent NaN attenuation
fix: Use COLORS.subtext; tighten AttenPreset cast; add tsc --noEmit to CI

title: LiTr MediaTransformer never released
impact: HandlerThread/resource leak per transcode leads to thread exhaustion/OOM
fix: Make MediaProcessor Closeable and call mediaTransformer.release() in finally; UUID requestIds

title: decodeToPCM EOS drain breaks after one output buffer
impact: Truncated PCM tail on some codecs
fix: Drain until BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM or bounded retries

title: Recording lacks fftSize delay compensation present in file path
impact: ~20ms offset, cold-start transient, different output for same audio
fix: Prime inputBuffer with fftSize zeros and skip first fftSize outputs in recording too

title: handleDenoise has no cancellation/unmount guard
impact: Runaway ONNX loop after navigation; setState on unmounted; leaked staged PCM
fix: Add abortedRef/AbortSignal checked in hot loop; cleanup staged files in finally

title: player.release() called on focus blur, not unmount
impact: Double-free / black video when returning to screen
fix: Only pause() on blur; let useVideoPlayer own release

title: updateSettings swallows write errors; racy incrementDenoiseCount; shared DEFAULT_SETTINGS by reference
impact: Silent settings loss, lost counts, mutable global default
fix: Atomic temp+rename write; surface errors; freeze/clone defaults

title: Settings change during in-flight load is ignored; loadPromise cleared before release completes
impact: Wrong engine config; overlapping sessions
fix: Await release before clearing; key the load promise by settings

title: Import reuse by name+size only; keys use mtime not content hash
impact: Different file with same name+size silently reuses old bytes; stale/wrong cached output
fix: Hash file content into buildInputIdentity; include model+engine version in keys

title: Process-screen strength presets/slider never persisted
impact: Screens disagree; choice forgotten; sidebar out of sync
fix: Call updateSettings({attenPreset/attenLimDb}) on change

title: Un-awaited index writes, non-atomic read-modify-write, no lock, errors swallowed
impact: Concurrent runs clobber indexes; breaks on SDK 58 where File.write is async
fix: await file.write; module-level mutex; temp+rename; propagate errors

title: Hardcoded hopSize=512 / fftSize=960 duplicates model_metadata.json
impact: Model swap silently desyncs framing
fix: Import constants from metadata/Denoiser

title: Per-chunk resample with no phase carry, no anti-alias filter; inputSamples is raw count
impact: Boundary clicks/aliasing at non-48k sources
fix: Carry fractional phase + resampler state across chunks; add low-pass for downsampling

title: processFrame does not zero inputFrameData before set(frame)
impact: Stale tail replayed if a short frame is ever passed
fix: inputFrameData.fill(0) before set

title: attenLimDb baked into Tensor at setupStreaming
impact: Changing strength mid-stream/preload has no effect
fix: Expose setAttenLimDb() that mutates the tensor data

title: State write-back assumes output order; metadata.state_input_names ignored
impact: Reordered model export corrupts all recurrent state silently
fix: Map by explicit state_input_names / output name mapping

title: lastEngine records attempted provider; provider objects cast as string[]
impact: UI can claim NNAPI/GPU while running CPU; type checking defeated
fix: Verify actual providers after create(); type executionProviders properly

title: suggestCoreLevel never returns 8; uses app name instead of device name
impact: Auto cores always 2/4; device hint regex is meaningless
fix: Use device model APIs; allow 8 for big-core devices

title: ArraytoPCM uses btoa binary-string path instead of Uint8Array writes
impact: ~10x slower; also dead code
fix: Delete or switch to Uint8Array write used elsewhere

title: stage_dec/stage_dn PCM deliberately excluded from cleanupTempCache
impact: Failed/aborted runs leak PCM files permanently
fix: Track staged files and delete on failure; add patterns with age limit

title: Recording result WAVs live in OS cache and match cleanupTempCache patterns
impact: OS eviction or home remount can delete results being viewed/shared
fix: Use placeOutput() into Paths.document like file processing

title: Two independent useIncomingShare subscribers with racing clearSharedPayloads
impact: Duplicate processing of one shared payload
fix: Single share provider/hook with one guarded handler

title: Module SilenceTrimNativeConfig omits removeInternalPauses read by Kotlin (default false)
impact: Type drift silently disables internal-pause removal for typed callers
fix: Add removeInternalPauses to the module type

title: Trim forcibly disabled for video so entire video-trim window path is unreachable
impact: ~120 lines native trim logic never runs
fix: Either enable video trim with re-encode or delete the dead path

title: Video timestamps rebased to trimStartUs but writing starts at next keyframe
impact: Up to one GOP of A/V desync (latent until AUD-25 enabled)
fix: Rebase to actual first keyframe time

title: Version conflict 1.6.0 / 1.5.0 / 1.4.4 (config wins); changelog stops at 1.5
impact: UI likely shows 1.4.4; release traceability broken
fix: Single source of truth; update changelog

title: Regex replaces first android { with unclosed block relying on original brace
impact: Fragile, duplicate buildTypes, not idempotent
fix: Use proper config-plugin merge or expo-build-properties

title: Declares apple+web with no implementations; web.ts referenced but absent
impact: Non-Android builds fail at requireNativeModule
fix: Declare android only; fix stale comment

title: kotlinx-coroutines-android 1.3.9 pinned; compileSdk 36 not explicitly installed in CI
impact: Version conflicts / CI build failure
fix: Use useCoreDependencies versions; install SDK 36 explicitly

title: No lockfile committed; frozen-lockfile || install; bun latest; exact-version patches vs ^ ranges
impact: Non-reproducible builds or failing postinstall
fix: Commit bun.lock; pin Bun; align dependency ranges with patch names

title: reset-project script references missing ./scripts/reset-project.js
impact: Script crashes if run
fix: Remove script or add the file

title: Legacy READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE on targetSdk 36; upstream package id; reactCompiler without explicit plugin dep
impact: Play policy risk; package collision; verify compiler plugin
fix: Remove legacy perms; rename package; verify babel-plugin-react-compiler

title: steps.indexOf(value) = -1 jumps thumb to 0; stepCount divides by zero for single step
impact: Wrong slider position; possible NaN

title: setTimeout state updates without cleanup
impact: setState on unmounted component
fix: Clear timer in useEffect cleanup

title: CoroutineScope without SupervisorJob; OnDestroy cancels without rejecting promises
impact: One failure can cancel siblings; in-flight promises hang
fix: SupervisorJob(); settle promises on cancellation

title: Typo 'without any ascii symbols'; bug reports and funding still point to upstream sayampy
impact: Confusing message; reports/donations go to wrong repo
fix: Fix wording; point to fork repo; remove or update funding

title: Upstream boilerplate names Sayam Goswami/email and claims third-party IP/Log Data collection
impact: Contradicts README no-analytics claim; store compliance risk
fix: Rewrite privacy policy for this fork
